health_workout_mapping.notes: HealthKit HKWorkoutActivityType names (as the adapter stringifies them) to activity type IDs. Unlisted kinds import as history only, mapped to the fallback type.

goal_templates.title: Train strength for 30 min
lines: Iron does not care how you feel. Lift anyway.
Thirty minutes under load. That is the whole ask.
Every set you log, I get a little heavier to knock down.

goal_templates.title: Log a workout with 12 sets
lines: Twelve sets. Count them, I will.
Not the longest session. The honest one.

goal_templates.title: Move for 30 min
lines: Thirty minutes of breath you have to earn.
Run, ride, swim. I am not picky, I am counting.

goal_templates.title: Go 45 min on your feet or wheels
lines: Longer today. Pace yourself; the end is where it counts.
Forty-five minutes. The city is wider than it looks.

goal_templates.title: Train combat for 30 min
lines: Half an hour of someone trying to hit you. Builds character, apparently.
Rounds today. Keep your hands up.

goal_templates.title: Yoga or stretching, 20 min
lines: Twenty minutes of being kind to the joints.
Range of motion is a stat too. It just does not shout.

goal_templates.title: Study or read for 30 min
lines: Thirty minutes of the page. The gym can wait a day.
Knowledge compounds. So do skipped days.

goal_templates.title: Sit for 15 min
lines: Fifteen minutes of nothing. Harder than it sounds.
Breath in, breath out, repeat until the noise drops.

goal_templates.title: Walk for 20 min
lines: Rest day. Legs still get a word in.
A walk clears the ledger. Twenty minutes.

goal_templates.title: Stretch for 10 min
lines: Rest means repair. Ten minutes of stretching helps the repair.
Tomorrow's lift is built today, slowly.

goal_templates.title: Walk {target} steps
lines: Rest day. The city still wants your steps.
{target} steps. No pace required, only the count.

goal_templates.title: Read for 10 min
lines: Ten pages or ten minutes. Either counts.
A chapter a day. Quietly, the shelf fills.

goal_templates.title: Study something for 20 min
lines: Twenty minutes on the thing you keep meaning to learn.
Sit with a hard topic. It gets smaller.

goal_templates.title: Write down one idea you learned today
lines: One idea, one line. Proof it went in.
Tell me one thing you know now that you did not this morning.

goal_templates.title: Listen to something that teaches, 15 min
lines: Fifteen minutes of someone smarter than both of us.
Ears work while the legs rest.

goal_templates.title: Practise a skill for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes of drills. Boring is how it sticks.
Practice does not need to be pretty. It needs to be today.

goal_templates.title: Replace one scroll with one page
lines: Trade a scroll for a page. Same thumb, better outcome.
One feed less, one page more.

goal_templates.title: Explain something you know to someone
lines: Teach it and you keep it.
Say it out loud to anyone. The dog counts.

goal_templates.title: Review yesterday's notes for 5 min
lines: Five minutes with yesterday. Memory likes a second look.
Re-read. Recall. Move on.

goal_templates.title: Sit quietly for 5 min
lines: Five minutes. No phone, no plan.
Short sit. The point is that it happened.

goal_templates.title: Breathwork, 10 rounds
lines: Ten slow rounds. Count them for me.
Breathe like you mean it. Ten times.

goal_templates.title: Walk without headphones for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes with only the street for company.
Unplug the ears. The city has a soundtrack already.

goal_templates.title: Write three lines about today
lines: Three lines. Not a diary, a receipt.
What happened, what you felt, what is next. Three lines.

goal_templates.title: Name one thing that went right
lines: One thing that went right. Say it, do not just think it.
Even a bad day has one line worth keeping.

goal_templates.title: Get 10 min of daylight
lines: Daylight on the face. Ten minutes. Non-negotiable.
Go outside. The screen will keep.

goal_templates.title: One meal without a screen
lines: Eat one meal looking at the food.
No screen at the table. Radical, I know.

goal_templates.title: Lie still for 5 min and notice your body
lines: Five minutes flat. Feet to head. Notice what hurts.
A scan, not a nap. Though I will not tell.

goal_templates.title: Drink a glass of water
lines: Water. Now. Then we talk.
Hydration is the cheapest stat boost there is.

goal_templates.title: Stretch for 2 min
lines: Two minutes. Hamstrings, shoulders, done.
Short stretch. Long-term knees.

goal_templates.title: Walk for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes on foot. Even to nowhere.
A short walk counts. It always has.

goal_templates.title: Take the stairs once
lines: Stairs over lift. One flight is enough.
The lift is for groceries. Today you are not groceries.

goal_templates.title: Do 10 push-ups
lines: Ten push-ups, anywhere. The floor is everywhere.
Ten. Form over speed.

goal_templates.title: Do 15 bodyweight squats
lines: Fifteen squats. Kitchen, office, platform, your call.
Legs remember being used. Remind them.

goal_templates.title: Hold a plank for 30 s
lines: Thirty seconds. Breathe through it.
A plank is just standing up, sideways.

goal_templates.title: Fix your posture right now
lines: Shoulders back. There, done. Next.
Sit up. I can tell when you slump.

goal_templates.title: Take three slow breaths
lines: Three breaths. In for four, out for six.
Slow the breath, slow the day.

goal_templates.title: Eat one vegetable
lines: One vegetable. Green preferred, not required.
Fuel matters. Pick something that grew.

goal_templates.title: Set a bedtime for tonight
lines: Pick a bedtime. Keeping it is tomorrow's win.
Sleep is when the gains get written.

goal_templates.title: Tidy one surface
lines: One surface. Desk, table, the chair that is a wardrobe.
Order outside helps order inside. Two minutes.

goal_templates.title: Step outside for 5 min
lines: Five minutes of sky. Clouds count.
Go stand outside. Come back. That is it.

goal_templates.title: Message someone you have been meaning to
lines: One message. Short is fine.
Someone is waiting on a reply. Be the one who sends it.

goal_templates.title: Write tomorrow's one task
lines: One task for tomorrow. Written, not remembered.
Decide tonight so tomorrow does not have to.

goal_templates.title: Skip one sugary drink
lines: One less sugar bomb. The body notices.
Water instead. See the other goal.

goal_templates.title: Finish your shower cold for 20 s
lines: Twenty seconds cold. Loud, brief, worth it.
The cold ends. The pride does not.

goal_templates.title: Hang from something for 20 s
lines: Twenty seconds hanging. Grip is a stat nobody trains.
Find a bar. Hold on. Count.

goal_templates.title: First 15 min awake without the phone
lines: Wake up before the feed does.
Fifteen minutes of morning that are yours.

goal_templates.title: Stand up and move once an hour
lines: Up every hour. Chairs are a slow enemy.
Stand, roll the shoulders, sit. Repeat all day.

goal_templates.title: Balance on one leg, 30 s each
lines: Thirty seconds a side. Harder than it looks, better than it feels.
Ankles vote too. Train them.

goal_templates.title: One song, full attention
lines: One song, nothing else. Three minutes of focus.
Listen. Just listen.

goal_templates.title: Make something for 30 min
lines: Thirty minutes of making. Ugly is allowed; absent is not.
Draw, play, write. The city has enough consumers.

goal_templates.title: Sketch for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes with a pencil. Nobody has to see it.
Draw the thing in front of you. Badly is fine.

goal_templates.title: Play or practise music for 15 min
lines: Fifteen minutes of noise with intent.
Scales count. Humming does not.

goal_templates.title: Journal for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes on the page. Write what happened, then what you felt.
A journal is a receipt for the day.

goal_templates.title: Take one deliberate photograph
lines: One photo, chosen. Not forty, taken.
Find a frame in this city and keep it.

goal_templates.title: Write down three ideas
lines: Three ideas. Two will be bad. That is the point.
Ideas rot unwritten. Three, now.

goal_templates.title: Finish one small creative thing
lines: Finish something. Small counts. Finished counts more.
A done sketch beats a perfect plan.

depart_lines: The Under City at this hour. I will be back before the rain changes.
Four hours. Do not wait up; do something useful instead.
Goals done, so I go. That was the deal.
away_lines: Somewhere below the overpass. Signal is bad.
Still walking. The city is longer than the map says.
Not back yet. Keep the light on.

common: Back. Nothing dramatic, a route I had not taken. It counts.
The district was quiet. I walked it anyway.
uncommon: Back. Someone down there knew my name before I said it. Odd.
Found a stairwell that was not on any map. Noted.
rare: Back, and not the same. Something under the city looked at me and let me pass.
There is a door down there with my name scratched into it. I did not open it. Yet.

quests.notification_prompt: Time to see if I can find anything useful around here. I'll be back in a few hours.
quests.subtext: This place is a MESS. I'll let you know if I find anything useful down here.

characters.notes: Name undecided (owner, 2026-10-02). Constant figure; portrait is the approved wise-guide-v1.
Hooded still until the player answers who they are; the live sprite's crop afterwards.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Wha.. Where am I?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Ah good, you're awake.
That was a nasty uplink, one of the worst I've seen yet.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: ...Uplink?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Yes my child..

lines.text: You've awoken in this, our digital world of {world}.
lines.without_world: You've awoken in this, our digital world.

lines: When a human in the real world decides to take the Ascension challenge, you become **soul bound** to them.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Soul bound? Sounds.. serious.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It is.
It means right now your survival depends on the determination of your human.
Their actions in the real world make you stronger here.
But also, their failures are your failures.
My human gave up on me a long time ago..
But I see something powerful in your bond...
Perhaps you could even reach Ascension one day!

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Ascension?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Ascension, yes. Grow strong enough and you can bend the very fabric of this world...
To ascend is to become powerful enough even to *escape* this digital world.
It's a lot, I know. We'll talk about it more.
...Do you remember anything about your real, human self?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's it, then. The bond holds.
Your human has taken the challenge. From here, every step they take in their world is a step you take in this one.
Many humans neglect themselves. It's in their nature to give up.
Not this one. Not if I can help it.
You'd better get to training. I'll be with you all the while.

daily_quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labour does the body.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
Nothing great is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig.
The body is the servant of the mind.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Vision without action is a daydream. Action without vision is a nightmare.
